turns.text: Hello, is that Bernard? This is an automated call from Fieldgate Surgery, following up on your appointment. I am not able to take questions, but the practice will read everything you tell me. If you would rather not talk now, just hang up and we will not call again.

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: Yes, that's me. Go on then.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Since your appointment, are you feeling better, about the same, or worse?

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: Better, I'd say. The swelling has gone down a lot since last week.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Is there anything you would like the practice to know?

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: No, I think I'm alright. Thank you for checking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like to be seen again about this?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Someone at the practice will read this today. Goodbye.
